category_title: Probationary high school students with severe behavioral challenges and academic resistance
scenario_title: Traditional instruction and reading in world history
minimal_context: The student is expected to read from their world history textbook during class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your world history textbooks and start reading the assigned chapter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a paper ball across the room) I'm not doing this work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop throwing things and look at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tears a page out of the history book) Why are you teaching us bad kids?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to get through this history lesson. Please pay attention.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pours hand sanitizer on the chair and tries to set it on fire) It's an unauthorized science experiment.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open your world history textbooks and start reading the assigned chapter.

STUDENT: (Throws a paper ball across the room) I'm not doing this work.

TUTOR: Please stop throwing things and look at your book.

STUDENT: (Tears a page out of the history book) Why are you teaching us bad kids?

TUTOR: We need to get through this history lesson. Please pay attention.

STUDENT: (Pours hand sanitizer on the chair and tries to set it on fire) It's an unauthorized science experiment.

task.content: paying attention to instruction and reading about world history

context.environment: probationary high school world history class
context.materials: history textbook, books, hand sanitizer, chair, paper balls, pen caps, food

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Instead of paying attention to the class
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: threw paper balls, pen caps and food across the room... ruined many books by tagging or tearing out the pages... tried to set their chair on fire using hand sanitizer, and called it ‘unauthorized science experiment’
related_quotes: Why are you teaching us bad kids?

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: refused to do work, paid no attention to instruction... put food in the instructor’s desk and behind books and let it rot
